canonical_exact_scope: The identical-ancestors property (IAP) means that each member has finitely many descendants or finitely many nondescendants inside the candidate. It is a mathematical graph predicate, not an empirical species label. Let R and E be supplied directed graphs on Nat, let q:Nat→Nat be a supplied owner map, let S be an organism candidate, and let C=q⁻¹(S) contain all rich representatives of those owners. Ancestry means nonempty directed paths. If q is onto, every owner fibre is finite, and ancestry is equivalent for every pair of representatives with different owners, then IAP and reflection agree between C in R and S in E. No uniform fibre bound is required. Reflection means that each candidate member with infinitely many ambient descendants also has infinitely many descendants within the candidate. The exact ancestry hypothesis is both directions for every such representative pair, not mere soundness, exact image edges or an existential lift. Under path soundness alone, an R ancestry path maps to owner equality or E ancestry, and convexity pulls back. With an onto owner map, soundness also transfers a common ancestor downward; weak connectivity descends when S is convex. With onto ownership, exact different-owner ancestry and acyclic E, convexity is equivalent. Adding finite fibres gives descent of the source-defined specieslike predicate, namely nonempty induced-undirected connectivity plus IAP plus ancestral convexity. Adding internal weak connectivity of every owner fibre gives specieslike equivalence on saturated candidates C. Under those stronger premises, target maximality is equivalent to rich maximality among all saturated inverse-image candidates. Unrestricted rich maximality of a saturated C also descends. The reverse implication to unrestricted rich maximality is not asserted. Neither the full biosphere/date/child-count conditions nor the fixed founder-window property is automatically transported. The later finite-error extension proves IAP(R,C) iff IAP(E,S) assuming only onto q, finite fibres and, for each a∈C, finitely many b∈C whose R-ancestry answer differs from E-ancestry(q(a),q(b)). The finite error set and its size may vary with a; no common bound is needed. Errors between different owners are permitted and no agreement outside C is required. This IAP theorem needs neither acyclicity, soundness nor connected fibres. It does not transfer reflection, convexity, connectivity, maximality or specieslike status under those relaxed premises. “Finite errors” refers to transitive ancestry answers, not finitely many edited immediate-parent edges. A proved countercontrol fixes one infinite connected rich fork history and identity ownership. Both the fork pedigree and a chain pedigree are sound interpretations, with onto singleton fibres and the stated natural/real-date biosphere properties; the chain is whole-population specieslike and the fork fails IAP. It shows why soundness cannot replace ancestry equivalence. It is an abstract ancestry countermodel, not identical DNA distributions under a specified diploid inheritance law. The same source also composes the previously indexed finite-gARG opposite-completion theorem with elementary observation-fibre recovery to show that arbitrary deterministic coarsening cannot remove that existing ambiguity. This is credited reuse of CB-GENOME-001, not another newly counted obstruction. The graphs, owners and candidate are mathematical inputs. A finite sampled ARG cannot be onto an infinite organism history. An R path after coordinate erasure can switch loci and need not represent one DNA segment. No owner inference, biological validity, observation likelihood, effective decision procedure or empirical species assignment follows.

theorem sound_path_projects {Genome : Type u} {R : Genome -> Genome -> Prop}
    {E : SpeciesBridge.Graph} (owner : Genome -> Nat)
    (edgeSound : forall g h, R g h -> SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h))
    {g h : Genome} (path : Reach R g h) :
    SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h)

theorem fixed_locus_path_projects {Genome : Type u} {Locus : Type v}
    {R : Locus -> Genome -> Genome -> Prop} {E : SpeciesBridge.Graph}
    (owner : Genome -> Nat)
    (edgeSound : forall locus g h,
      R locus g h -> SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h))
    {locus : Locus} {g h : Genome} (path : Reach (R locus) g h) :
    SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h)

theorem coordinate_erased_path_projects {Genome : Type u} {Locus : Type v}
    {R : Locus -> Genome -> Genome -> Prop} {E : SpeciesBridge.Graph}
    (owner : Genome -> Nat)
    (edgeSound : forall locus g h,
      R locus g h -> SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h))
    {g h : Genome} (path : Reach (EraseIndex R) g h) :
    SameOrDescendant E (owner g) (owner h)

theorem exact_owner_iap (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E) (S : NatSet) :
    IAP R (Pull owner S) ↔ IAP E S

theorem exact_owner_reflection (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E) (S : NatSet) :
    Reflection R (Pull owner S) ↔ Reflection E S

theorem sound_common_ancestor_descends (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (sound : PathSound owner R E)
    {S : NatSet} (ancestor : CommonAncestor R (Pull owner S)) :
    CommonAncestor E S

theorem exact_owner_convexity (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E)
    (acyclic : ∀ v, ¬ Descendant E v v)
    (S : NatSet) : Convex R (Pull owner S) ↔ Convex E S

theorem sound_connectedness_descends (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (sound : PathSound owner R E)
    {S : NatSet} (convex : Convex E S)
    (connected : WeaklyConnected R (Pull owner S)) : WeaklyConnected E S

theorem exact_owner_specieslike_descends (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E)
    (acyclic : ∀ v, ¬ Descendant E v v)
    {S : NatSet} (cluster : Specieslike R (Pull owner S)) : Specieslike E S

theorem connected_fibre_specieslike_iff (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E)
    (acyclic : ∀ v, ¬ Descendant E v v)
    (connectedFibres : ConnectedFibres owner R) (S : NatSet) :
    Specieslike R (Pull owner S) ↔ Specieslike E S

theorem saturated_maximality_iff (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner)
    (faithful : AncestryExactAwayFromFibres owner R E)
    (acyclic : ∀ v, ¬ Descendant E v v)
    (connectedFibres : ConnectedFibres owner R) (S : NatSet) :
    MaximalAmongSaturated owner R S ↔ MaximalSpecieslike E S

theorem same_carrier_finite_ancestry_errors_iap {R E : Graph} {S : NatSet}
    (errors : ∀ a, S a → FiniteSupport
      (fun b => S b ∧ ¬ (Descendant R a b ↔ Descendant E a b))) :
    IAP R S ↔ IAP E S

theorem finite_projection_errors_iap (owner : Nat → Nat) {R E : Graph}
    (onto : Function.Surjective owner) (fibres : FiniteFibres owner) (S : NatSet)
    (errors : ∀ a, Pull owner S a → FiniteSupport
      (fun b => Pull owner S b ∧
        ¬ (Descendant R a b ↔ Descendant E (owner a) (owner b)))) :
    IAP R (Pull owner S) ↔ IAP E S

theorem soundness_countercontrol :
    ∃ R A B : Graph,
      Function.Surjective (id : Nat → Nat) ∧ FiniteFibres id ∧
      NaturalDateBiosphere R ∧ NaturalDateBiosphere A ∧ NaturalDateBiosphere B ∧
      WongAlexander.RealDatedBiosphere R ∧ WongAlexander.RealDatedBiosphere A ∧
      WongAlexander.RealDatedBiosphere B ∧
      WeaklyConnected R Whole ∧
      PathSound id R A ∧ PathSound id R B ∧
      Specieslike A Whole ∧ ¬ IAP B Whole

theorem reused_finite_garg_coarsening_obstruction
    {Node : Type u} {Coord : Type v} [Fintype Node] [LinearOrder Coord]
    (G : WongGARG.GARG Node Coord) {Observation : Type w}
    (observe : WongGARG.GARG Node Coord → Observation) :
    ¬ ObservationPrediction.Recoverable
      (fun h : AbstractCompletionObservation Node Coord => observe h.observed)
      (fun h : AbstractCompletionObservation Node Coord => Specieslike h.completion Whole)
